plan: Given my value of $36, I aim to bid slightly below my value to maximize profit while having a strong chance to win. Assuming others bid around their values, a bid around $35 could secure a win without overpaying. If others bid higher, I lose and pay nothing. If I bid lower, I risk losing potential profit. Thus, bidding $35 balances risk and reward effectively.

Given my value of $33, I aim to bid slightly below my value to maximize profit while winning. Assuming others bid near their values, I will bid $32.5, just under my value, to potentially win without overpaying. If others bid higher, I lose but avoid overpaying. If others bid lower, I win and pay one of their bids, maximizing my profit.

My value is $31, so I aim to bid slightly above the expected average of $24.5 to increase my chances of winning. I expect others to bid close to their values. If I bid too low, I risk losing; too high, I overpay. I'll bid $27 to maximize profit potential by winning while paying a lower third-highest bid.
